sections.title: Roll to cast
sections.md:
Every cast is a **casting check**: d20 + 5 vs **DC 10 + the spell's level** (cantrips DC 10).

- Success: the spell works.
- Failure: it *fizzles* and is lost until a Long Rest.
- Natural 20: double one numeric effect.
- Natural 1: lost, and roll `1d12` on the mishap table.

### The mishap table

| d12 | Mishap |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Backlash.** 2d6 force damage. |
| 4 | **Snuffed.** Light within 9 m goes out. |
| 12 | **Fizzle.** Nothing else happens. |

sections.title: Death is a respawn
sections.md: He revives at the entrance camp at full HP, with every spell back. He **loses the coins he carried**; everything else stays.

sections.title: The pieces
sections.md: A piece is something a realm put on the map: soldiers (Force), spies (Cunning) or income (Wealth). The ring round a token is its health.
